text:
ashley: T-minus ~17:10 PDT deploy for feature/snapshot-rollout. Quick runbook check — can everyone confirm rollback criteria + who'll run smoke? Runbook: https://runbook.internal/deploys/snapshot-undo v2. TL;DR: rollback if >=5% 5m error rate OR p90 latency >2x baseline OR failed billing/background jobs. Also need DB toggle readiness.

matt: I'll own the deploy and the rollback exec if needed. Planning to push at 17:10, can hand off route revert to raj.

raj: Oncall for the window — monitoring infra/alerts. I can flip routing and run the network-level revert. +1 for the 5% err threshold as trigger.

sasha: I'll run the smoke steps: staging full, then prod canary smoke. Smoke checklist (short): 1) L7 health checks, 2) embeddings sanity on a sample prompt, 3) run a couple of background job test vectors. I'll post results in-thread.

olivia: DB toggle and migration guard are set. Commands in runbook step 3:
```
# mark service ready for rollback ops
kubectl annotate svc snapshot --overwrite rollback-ready=true
# rollback helper (dry-run supported)
./scripts/rollback.sh --env=prod --tag=canary --dry-run
```
I verified permissions for matt + raj.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by matt at 17:10 PDT. Canary config: 5% traffic for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> 100% if canary healthy.

ashley: OK. Who will call final go/no-go at canary end (17:20 PDT)? What exact pass/fail metrics do we use for the call?

matt: I'll make the final call. Concrete canary pass criteria: error rate (5m) < 1%, ingestion lag < 30s, critical job success rate 100% (no failures), and no regressions in cost metrics > 2x baseline. If any fail, we rollback.

sasha: If I see anything odd during the 5% canary I'll call rollback immediately. Also request: disable KV cache eviction during canary so caches don't cold-start and skew latency.

olivia: KV eviction flag toggled off across canary nodes. Confirmed.

raj: If rollback is needed I will start network route revert (runbook step 6). matt, please ensure the route revert snippet is ready in your window notes.

matt: will paste the route revert snippet before the push. It's two commands and a sanity check.

ashley: Final owner list: deploy=matt, smoke=sasha, oncall=raj, toggles=olivia. Everyone ack?

matt: ack :thumbsup:

sasha: ack

raj: standing by

olivia: ack — all infra flags green

deploy-bot: Canary start scheduled at 17:10 PDT. Good luck! :rocket:

ashley: (17:25 PDT) Final: go from matt after canary metrics. Rolling forward to 100%. Will log post-deploy summary in #deploy-postmortems.

matt: go — no anomalies observed during canary. Closing ticket and clearing rollback window.
